page.layout: One printed page of running text in the main column, with a diagram of braces in the middle; a marginal note column to the left ("De sacerdo-dotio christi. cap.6."); a sliver of the facing page on the right edge. Page number 69 at the top right of the header.

main_text.l: Sacerdotium Christi est prima pars muneris
qua in ijs omnibus constituitur quæ apud Deum a-
genda sunt, ita vt possit παντελές, siue prorsus
seruare eos qui ad Deum per ipsos accedunt. Heb.5.1.
peragendi munus.} Esa.61.2.3.4.Dan. 9.Ep.2.14.17. Heb. 3. cap. ad 11. 1.
Prophetia est prima pars sacerdotij, qua totum
Dei verbum perfectè reuelauit ecclesiæ. Ioha.15.15.
per {Christi inspirationem. / Ipsius actionem.} Heb.2.3.Gal.1.11.12. Ier.1.9.
Christi inspiratio, est actio Deitatis suæ, qua ver-
bum θεοπνεύστον per nuncios suos eloquitur. 2.Sam. 23.2.

page.notes: Right edge shows a sliver of the facing page (fragments such as "23.2.3", "Nunc", "funt", "Re", "diate", "redem", "26.27", "13.14", "Act", "phe.2", "Sunt", "vel in", "14.26") which is show-through/edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Greek words are transcribed as best legible; "παντελές" and "θεοπνεύστον" are doubtful [?] readings: the first line of the mediation bracket and the Greek of the first Greek word are uncertain.
